ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level distribution shows a high-contrast ratio of approximately 65% high-intensity (white) pixels to 35% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive black mottling concentrated along leading and trailing edges; a solid low-intensity base region at the fluke center extending into fractal-like patterns; two large high-intensity contiguous regions occupy the central-medial area of each lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 70 degrees relative to the lobe horizontal axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous boundary exhibiting irregular low-frequency, medium-amplitude peaks along the distal edges; trailing edges show jagged serrations with more pronounced irregularities on the left lobe viewer-side distal third.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex posterior curve fitted to both lobes, tapering to narrow, acute tips on the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-intensity circular pixel clusters (white) localized on the low-intensity dark central peduncle region; small dark focal spots distributed across the white interior of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel disruptions visible on the high-intensity background of the right lobe (viewer perspective), oriented diagonally towards the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent horizontal high-intensity (white) linear scar located centrally on the dark peduncle area; dark focal lesion with a vertical trail visible on the medial interior of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible biological encrustations (likely barnacles) disrupting the smooth pixel boundary at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
